title: Investigating the Mechanisms of Bisdemethoxycurcumin in Ulcerative Colitis: Network Pharmacology and Experimental Verification.
authors: Wu, Huihuan; Tu, Sha; Zhuo, Zewei; Jiang, Rui; Zeng, Ruijie; Yang, Qi; Lian, Qizhou; Sha, Weihong; Chen, Hao
one_liner_zh: 该文通过网络药理学和分子对接研究姜黄素类似物治疗溃疡性结肠炎的靶点与通路，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Ulcerative colitis is a chronic inflammatory bowel disorder that is hard to cure once diagnosed. Bisdemethoxycurcumin has shown positive effects on inflammatory diseases. However, the underlying bioactive interaction between bisdemethoxycurcumin and ulcerative colitis is unclear. The objective of this study was to determine the core target and potential mechanism of action of bisdemethoxycurcumin as a therapy for ulcerative colitis. The public databases were used to identify potential targets for bisdemethoxycurcumin and ulcerative colitis. To investigate the potential mechanisms, the protein-protein interaction network, gene ontology analysis, and Kyoto encyclopedia of genes and genomes analysis have been carried out. Subsequently, experimental verification was conducted to confirm the findings. A total of 132 intersecting genes of bisdemethoxycurcumin, as well as ulcerative coli-tis-related targets, were obtained. SRC, EGFR, AKT1, and PIK3R1 were the targets of highest potential, and the PI3K/Akt and MAPK pathways may be essential for the treatment of ulcerative colitis by bisdemethoxycurcumin. Molecular docking demonstrated that bisdemethoxycurcumin combined well with SRC, EGFR, PIK3R1, and AKT1. Moreover, the in vitro experiments suggested that bisdemethoxycurcumin might reduce LPS-induced pro-inflammatory cytokines levels in RAW264.7 cells by suppressing PI3K/Akt and MAPK pathways. Our study provided a comprehensive overview of the potential targets and molecular mechanism of bisdemethoxycurcumin against ulcerative colitis. Furthermore, it also provided a theoretical basis for the clinical treatment of ulcerative colitis, as well as compelling evidence for further study on the mechanism of bisdemethoxycurcumin in the treatment of ulcerative colitis.
abstract_zh: 溃疡性结肠炎是一种慢性炎症性肠病，一旦确诊便难以治愈。双去甲氧基姜黄素在炎症性疾病中显示出积极效果。然而，双去甲氧基姜黄素与溃疡性结肠炎之间的潜在生物活性相互作用尚不清楚。本研究旨在确定双去甲氧基姜黄素治疗溃疡性结肠炎的核心靶点及潜在作用机制。利用公共数据库识别双去甲氧基姜黄素和溃疡性结肠炎的潜在靶点。为探究潜在机制，进行了蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络、基因本体论分析及京都基因与基因组百科全书分析。随后，通过实验验证以确认研究结果。共获得132个双去甲氧基姜黄素与溃疡性结肠炎相关靶点的交集基因。SRC、EGFR、AKT1和PIK3R1是最具潜力的靶点，PI3K/Akt和MAPK通路可能对双去甲氧基姜黄素治疗溃疡性结肠炎至关重要。分子对接表明，双去甲氧基姜黄素与SRC、EGFR、PIK3R1和AKT1结合良好。此外，体外实验提示，双去甲氧基姜黄素可能通过抑制PI3K/Akt和MAPK通路，降低RAW264.7细胞中脂多糖诱导的促炎细胞因子水平。我们的研究全面概述了双去甲氧基姜黄素对抗溃疡性结肠炎的潜在靶点和分子机制，同时为溃疡性结肠炎的临床治疗提供了理论基础，也为进一步研究双去甲氧基姜黄素治疗溃疡性结肠炎的机制提供了有力证据。
